task.title: To remove highlighting for smart and read-only fields

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Unhighlight Fields. If you do not see Unhighlight Fields under the Work tab, click the More button () and from the menu, select Unhighlight Fields.

note.p: If Highlight Fields is already selected in the Work menu and you mark a text in the agreement document as a smart field (using the "Mark Field" option), the marked field is not automatically highlighted. Click Unhighlight Fields and Highlight Fields in the Work menu to highlight the new field.
